The Boy Who Came Back to Boast
A cocky college senior returns to Maplewood Middle School to show off his grades, internship, and supposedly perfect future. When he mocks a quiet blonde student named Patricia for her pink hoodie, striped tights, and childish appearance, an unexplained magic turns his cruelty back on him. His clothes, body, face, voice, and place in the world are rewritten until he has become Patricia, while the real Patricia walks away in his former body and life.

Before he can find a way to reverse the change, Patricia's mother arrives and treats him as her daughter. She takes him to a home he does not remember and prepares him for a family celebration, dressing him in white tights, a formal white dress, and red Mary Jane shoes. The enchanted outfit refuses to come off, making it clear that the transformation is not temporary. Having just finished college, he now faces the terrifying reality of starting life over as a young girl whose identity everyone accepts as his own. The story ends with him reluctantly taking his new mother's hand and stepping into Patricia's life.
